website_summary.name: CodeCraft Studio
website_summary.description: The website resembles a streamlined version of Visual Studio Code, designed for coding and editing tasks within a web-based interface.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a dark-themed interface with a sidebar on the left labeled "EXPLORER," which lists files such as `index.tsx` and `README.md`. The main area displays a code editor with a placeholder comment "// Your React code here." At the top, there are navigation buttons for "Editor," "Chat," and "Terminal." The top-right corner includes icons for settings, branch status ("main*"), and problem notifications ("0 problems"). The bottom section contains buttons for saving and running code, along with indicators for the current line and column in the editor.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to edit and manage code files, switch between different file types, and execute code. It provides basic functionalities similar to a code editor, including saving changes, running scripts, and navigating through files via the explorer. Users can also toggle between different modes like Editor, Chat, and Terminal for various development tasks.
